question: What length measurements are prescribed for the ritual implement?
premises: The size of the implement is being specified.
An arm-length measure is also mentioned.
inference: Therefore, the implement may be made to the measure of a hand or of an arm.
uncertainties: Whether these are alternative measures or apply to different implements is not explicit in this verse.
plain_english: It should be of the measure of a hand or of the measure of an arm.
